verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents Unified Controls, an auditor-built single core control list that all offered frameworks map to. It publishes explicit SOC 2→Unified Control and HIPAA→Unified Control mappings, and its multi-framework action items mean requirements already met by another framework's controls don't need redoing. It also says it visualizes the differences between frameworks and shows framework controls alongside unified controls, filterable by framework. Missing for 10: ISO 27001 is never named in the mapping evidence, there is no detailed documentation of a dedicated overlap/coverage view, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
